title: Refund Timeline
html:
DC Metro Refund Policy
DC Metro Refund Policy
Golfweek Amateur Tour – DC Metro
Players must notify the Tour Director in advance to qualify for entry refunds or credits.

Any player who wishes to withdraw from a tournament can receive a full refund or transfer the credit to a future tournament.  The player must notify the Tour Director by Sunday night the week before the tournament.

Players may contact the Tour Director by:

  • Text message - 571.264.5625 (Please include your name in the text)
  • Email - dcmetro@amateurgolftour.net
  • Phone call - 571.264.5625

Refund Timeline

Before Sunday Night

Players who withdraw by Sunday night the week before the tournament receive a 100% refund.

Monday – Two Days Before Event

Once tournament numbers are submitted to the course on Monday morning, withdrawals may receive a 50% refund.

Two Days Before Tournament

There are NO REFUNDS two (2) days before the tournament date.

Policy Explanation

This policy is in place because golf courses hold the DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour responsible for the number of players submitted on the Monday before each tournament. The policy protects both the Tour and its players by establishing clear boundaries and accountability regarding tournament participation.
DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour
"Where Amateurs Play Like Pros!"
